ana_serrano_7: The new rifleman is Isidor Serrano, once a tram conductor from Old Harrow. The corporal asked if a tram conductor was any use in a trench. Isidor Serrano said he would find out.
Number 56 on the early rolls: Isidor Serrano. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F14, Isidor Serrano listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Isidor Serrano found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
romanbhassell: The sergeant gave Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 3 or any other.
Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas Solyommadar crossed it, Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel fired. Jonas Solyommadar was grazed.
